```php
<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use App\Models\Category;
use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;

class CategorySeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run()
    {
        $categories = [
            'Technology',
            'Science',
            'Art',
            'History',
            'Geography',
            'Business',
            'Health',
            'Sports',
            'Entertainment'
        ];

        foreach ($categories as $category) {
            Category::create([
                'name' => $category,
                'description' => "Description for {$category}"
            ]);
        }
    }
}
```
